szoveg_eredeti:
Google joins other global tech firms in expanding in Malaysia.

Alphabet Inc.’s Google said it plans to spend $15 billion to expand data center and cloud operations in Malaysia as the artificial intelligence boom fuels demand for digital infrastructure.

The company will build new computing hubs and invest in local water security, power generation and training of Malaysia’s residents, according to a statement on Wednesday. The investments are set to occur during 2027 and 2028, it said.
